user_answer: 按三版本主线收敛，保留必需类型（推荐）
other_dtype_policy: Only additional types required by the original program; no universal exhaustive caller dtype matrix. Preserve all already developed wider proofs and frozen evidence.
separation: Real mathematical proof does not imply floating correctness. Unsupported original BF16 is recorded explicitly; a new BF16 implementation is an independently identified variant.
migration: Keep existing full-original schema2 reviews and exact numerical checks. Introduce explicit per-version coverage mapping before declaring any program complete under the new three-version standard.
in_flight_batch: Four already reviewed wide-domain source packages are being integrated; source acceptance counts do not automatically imply all three primary versions have been reviewed.
